All three actions behave the way I expected. The review step is worth the small pause, especially if the real title and description will normally be filled in already; I can simply confirm them and save, or correct them when needed.

Opening the existing bookmark when I enter the same link again feels right, as does being able to edit it later. The quieter site line reads clearly as the source rather than one of my tags, and the editable description is in a sensible place.

For the finished version, I’d also expect the page’s preview image to be collected when one is available. Otherwise, I’m happy with this saving flow.
